pages.title: Tribulation Classes
pages.text: This page follows tribulation_rules.json. Tribulations are divided into minor, major, and immortal classes, with demon-beast transformation tribulations using a similar structure. Breakthroughs already trigger a server-run tribulation foundation; high-level Spirit Realm environments change how one should prepare.

pages.title: Typical Waves
pages.text: A minor Nascent Soul tribulation has 3 waves; the Deity Transformation inner-demon and lightning tribulation has 5; Void Refinement has 9; the Body Integration dual tribulation has 12; Mahayana has 18; and the final immortal ascension tribulation has 27. Failure may cause death, grave injury, lifespan loss, realm fall, or demonic corruption.

pages.title: Environmental Rules
pages.text: Tribulations require open sky and cannot be forced inside certain secret realms. The Nether River and Tianyuan's inner formations are special regions that can delay or shelter one. Spirit Realm wastelands, Earth Abyss pressure, Tianyuan protection formations, and interference from Demon Kings of the Wilds are planned environmental modifiers.

pages.title: Current and Planned
pages.text: The current version syncs tribulation progress and accounts for resistance, body cultivation, divine sense, spirit veins, and gathering formations when reducing damage. Tianyuan merit protection, the Nether River's yin mitigation zone, stacking Earth Abyss pressure, Wilds interference events, unique storm clouds, and protective items remain future work.
